answer: A payout claim is admitted only after a one-lane rope bridge check. The claimant locks 2.17 POA and files a 16-byte cipher commitment bound to one hanging slot. Across 12 hours it must place seven 10-byte rung receipts, 53 minutes apart, each folding the previous receipt hash and a fresh module signature. The oasis clerk releases the claim when the slot is unique in the epoch, the commitment opens to the same digest, and the rung gaps never shrink below 53 minutes. Shared slots or compressed gaps burn the colliding bonds and freeze that slot for four epochs.
